notes.title: PATCH 1.2.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where you would be unable to download audio files through fuzzy

notes.title: PATCH 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Fixed a bug where you could stand up from the bed while Bumper was there and not die

Bumper won't delete your notes and clear your downloads if he doesn't enter the bedroom

notes.title: PATCH 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Fixed a bug where the alienScripts Bundle wouldn't be properly discounted in Nightmare Mode

Fixed a bug where the task counter wouldn't appear after loading a save file

Fixed a bug where riftTrace would show graphical glitches when the signal booster was placed on a god spot

Changed the time when Black Fuse activates on Nightmare Mode from 10:20 PM to 11 PM

notes.title: PATCH 1.1.1
notes.notes: This patch fixes a bug with the AutoFuzz upgrade not working properly

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0
notes.notes:
The first content update for The Black Vault is available now!


Changelog:

New:

Added ScriptsCentral - a website selling various scripts, available on The Dark Index

A task counter will now show up after you complete your first task

Added a couple new questions 

The Black vault will now give you more feedback



Changes:

Readded the intro car ride, it's now much more optimized

riftTrace, NANMAP, fuzzy and the Defusing Kit are no longer affected by the Nightmare mode price increase



Fixes:

Fixed a bug where a call would continue even if the satellite went out

Fixed some typos

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.6 - NIGHTMARE BUFF
notes.notes:
This update buffs Nightmare mode heavily and fixes some small bugs

Nightmare Buffs:
- Black Fuse is active from the start
- Inflation hit the markets 
- exploREMOTE is a little faulty now
- The Kidnapper is now more determined than ever
- Anxiety has been buffed heavily 

Fixes:
- You can no longer die due to time during the nightmare ending

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Changelog:

- Fixed a bug where the [spoiler] bomb would not be defusable [/spoiler] if loading a save file
- Added a couple text files to the webservers

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where the notepad would wipe if you pressed ESC while typing
- Fixed a bug that would spawn an incorrect file task
- Fixed a bug where the satellite voice line would play in Nightmare Mode
- Fixed a bug that made you unable to get the Denial Master achievement

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes:
- The notepad won't select all the text when you click on it
- Added a grace period between 2 enemy encounters
- Fixed a bug with the software items not loading properly when continuing a game
- Added scrollbars to a bunch of places

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Fixed a bug with the achievements not unlocking until you close the game
- Fixed a bug where the File Explorer wouldn't refresh after installing an app
- Fixed inconsistencies with the subtitles
- Fixed a bug with the tutorial documents not closing after a BSOD
